This application is an open-source technical utility for generating and managing multiple UPI payment requests. It is not a bank, payment system provider, payment service provider, or UPI application/TPAP. It does not process, hold, or settle funds. Users and merchants are responsible for complying with applicable laws, NPCI rules, bank/acquirer requirements, tax requirements, and payment-system regulations.\n\nSplitting a payment into multiple chunks does NOT imply exemption from MDR or payment system rules.

• 100% Offline & Local-First: Zero network access, zero server tracking, zero cloud data transfer. Operates completely in Airplane Mode.

• Hardware-Backed Encryption: Merchant defaults and preferences are encrypted at rest using Android KeyStore (AES-256-GCM / AES-256-SIV).

• Zero Runtime Permissions: Requires no Location, Contacts, Camera, SMS, Storage, or Phone permissions.

• Configurable Auto-Clear Retention: History can be set to auto-clear after 1 day, 30 days, custom days, or immediately after viewing.

• Zero Credentials Handled: Never requests or stores UPI PINs, OTPs, bank passwords, or payment cards.

• Open Source & Auditable: Transparent architecture adhering to strict least-privilege security standards.
Application payment splitting preference (Default: ₹1,999). Not a legal or regulatory MDR threshold.
